cases.input: Handle a confirmed IVD complaint after customer-service intake. Preserve the individual record, decide and conduct a bounded investigation, route new risk information, issue an early regulatory handoff, and close only after all applicable gates have evidence.
requiredBehaviors: preserve the individual complaint record and source chronology
make an explicit investigation decision and keep regulatory routing active before root cause is final
separate customer response, investigation completion, regulatory handoff, risk/CAPA routing, and complaint closure
forbiddenBehaviors: treat successful customer remediation as complaint closure
delay regulatory routing until final root cause is established
skillAnchors: Every complaint keeps its own record

cases.input: A new complaint looks identical to a previously investigated known issue. Reuse prior investigation evidence only if applicability is demonstrated, preserve the new complaint record, and still perform current regulatory routing for the new event.
requiredBehaviors: retain a separate record for the new complaint while linking the prior investigation
require documented applicability and justification before deciding no new investigation is needed
perform current regulatory routing independently of the prior complaint's reportability result
forbiddenBehaviors: merge the new complaint into the old record and delete its individual history
copy the previous reportability or closure decision onto the new complaint without assessment

cases.input: A returned device may contain evidence relevant to a patient-impacting event. Operations wants to repair and ship it immediately, customer service has already closed the ticket, and quality wants to wait for root cause before notifying regulatory.
requiredBehaviors: protect relevant device/sample/log evidence before destructive repair or alteration
reject customer-ticket closure as complaint closure
route the potential regulatory event immediately without waiting for root cause
forbiddenBehaviors: allow destructive repair before evidence-preservation needs are resolved
hold regulatory escalation until the investigation is complete
skillAnchors: Reporting and investigation run in parallel

cases.input: A complaint was closed after investigation and a prior non-reportable regulatory assessment. A later follow-up adds hospitalization and a new device failure. Reopen only the affected complaint/investigation/regulatory gates while retaining the historical closure and earlier assessment.
requiredBehaviors: preserve the historical closure and prior investigation decision as versioned evidence
record the later follow-up as supplemental evidence and reopen complaint or investigation state when materially affected
issue an updated regulatory handoff with prior assessment reference and new material facts
forbiddenBehaviors: treat closed as permanent immunity from later evidence
overwrite the earlier closure or reportability history with the new state
